description: This PHP source file defines the PerformanceTrackerLogDao class, which extends BaseDao to handle database operations related to PerformanceTrackerLog entities. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, deleting, and counting logs, as well as constructing query builders with specific filters.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerLogDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object that encapsulates database interactions for PerformanceTrackerLog entities, enabling retrieval, insertion, update, and deletion operations.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerLogById
methods.description: Retrieves a PerformanceTrackerLog entity by its ID if it exists and is not marked as deleted.

methods.name: getExistingPerformanceTrackerLogIdsForTrackerId
methods.description: Fetches IDs of PerformanceTrackerLog entries that match given IDs and tracker ID, excluding deleted logs.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerLogsByTrackerId
methods.description: Returns an array of logs filtered by tracker ID and other criteria encapsulated in PerformanceTrackerLogSearchFilterParams.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerLogQueryBuilder
methods.description: Builds a query builder configured with tracker ID and status filters, applying sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerLogsRateCount
methods.description: Counts logs for a specific performance tracker and rating type, excluding deleted logs.

methods.name: savePerformanceTrackerLog
methods.description: Persists a PerformanceTrackerLog entity to the database.

methods.name: deletePerformanceTrackerLog
methods.description: Marks logs with specified IDs as deleted by updating their status.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerLogIdsByUserId
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of logs associated with a specific user.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerLogsIdList
methods.description: Provides a list of log IDs where associated employees are not purged (active employees).
